criterion: Behaviour narrowed to dodge / fix applied at one site while sibling path keeps old behaviour
finding: A separate git directory that is itself named `.git` still derives a worktree base, though the docstring, CONFIG.md and CHANGELOG say a separate git directory derives nothing.
why: worktree_base tests only the git directory's name, and the new test only covers a store named `x.git`, so the `.git`-named case is neither handled nor tested.
fix: Require the main checkout to hold the git directory as its own (compare the toplevel from the main worktree), or narrow the three docs, and test a `.git`-named separate directory.
